brief: 6 writing tips for founders who hate writing.

slots.headline: Six writing tips for founders who despise the blank page

slots.title: Talk It Out
slots.body: Record yourself explaining the idea, then transcribe the audio. Your natural voice is clearer than forced prose. Edit the transcript into clean copy.

slots.title: Steal a Structure
slots.body: Start with a proven outline instead of a blank screen. Fill in the sections one by one. Constraints make writing faster and less painful.

slots.title: Write a Bad Draft
slots.body: Give yourself permission to write the worst version first. You can't edit what doesn't exist. A rough draft is a necessary starting point.

slots.title: Argue With AI
slots.body: Tell an AI your point and ask it to poke holes. Defending your idea sharpens your message. Then capture the winning sentences.

slots.title: Cut Half the Words
slots.body: Founders overwrite because they fear sounding simple. Cut every sentence in half. Brevity builds trust and respects your reader's time.

slots.title: Write to One Person
slots.body: Pick a single customer and write them a letter. Personal focus removes corporate fluff. The result will resonate with many.
